components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Removes the werewolf side: a werewolf becomes human again, a hybrid or a tribrid a plain vampire. The gene stays.

Full-moon night only. The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does) and must be on the werewolf side. An Original hybrid cannot be cured by it.

Werewolves must be installed. A refusal gives the ingredients back.
